description: This PHP class defines the RekognitionClient, a client for interacting with Amazon Rekognition service via AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various Rekognition operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: RekognitionClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Rekognition service, extends AwsClient to provide specific methods for Rekognition operations.

methods.name: associateFaces
methods.description: Associates faces with a face ID or a collection ID.

methods.name: compareFaces
methods.description: Compares a face in the source image with faces in the target image.

methods.name: createCollection
methods.description: Creates a new collection for storing face metadata.

methods.name: createDataset
methods.description: Creates an Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels dataset.

methods.name: createFaceLivenessSession
methods.description: Creates a face Liveness session for anti-spoofing.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new Rekognition Custom Labels project.

methods.name: createProjectVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a model within a project.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user (potentially in an IAM context).

methods.name: describeStreamProcessor
methods.description: Provides information about a stream processor.

methods.name: detectModerationLabels
methods.description: Detects potentially unsafe or naughty content in images.

methods.name: detectProtectiveEquipment
methods.description: Detects protective equipment on people in images.

methods.name: detectText
methods.description: Detects text in images and videos.

methods.name: disassociateFaces
methods.description: Disassociates faces from a face ID or collection.

methods.name: getCelebrityInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about celebrities detected in images.

methods.name: getCelebrityRecognition
methods.description: Gets celebrity recognition results in images.

methods.name: getFaceLivenessSessionResults
methods.description: Retrieves results of face liveness sessions.

methods.name: getFaceSearch
methods.description: Search for matching faces in a collection.

methods.name: getPersonTracking
methods.description: Gets results of person tracking in videos.

methods.name: listProjectPolicies
methods.description: Lists policies attached to a project.

methods.name: putProjectPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a resource policy to a project.

methods.name: searchFaces
methods.description: Searches for faces in a collection.

methods.name: searchFacesByImage
methods.description: Searches for matching faces using an image.

methods.name: searchUsers
methods.description: Searches for users (specific context not detailed).

methods.name: searchUsersByImage
methods.description: Searches for users based on an image.
